data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Hello. I understand your frustration with the slow file downloads. Please test your download speeds using a different browser or network, and check for any browser extensions that might interfere with downloads. For very large files, we recommend that the recipient use a download manager if available, or for the sender to share via the Desktop Sync client which offers more robust transfer. Also, verify the server region for your workspace. [T-3225] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
